### New in 1.7.3
- **Google Sign-In & Firebase Auth Integration**:
  - Integrated Firebase Core, Firebase Auth, and Google Sign-In (`google_sign_in`).
  - Configured Android Gradle plugins (`google-services`) and app dependencies.
  - Added `AuthService` with Google Web Client ID for seamless authentication.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and install over your existing installation.
